text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like we're up. Let's go, C.B… 
Let's show 'em the way we roll full-on!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Alright,
Ace. C'mere.
Let's dance like no one's watching—
just you and me!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"A celebratory New Year's calligraphy
performance,"…?! 
We're… going to do that?!

That's… it's that thing,
right? I saw it on a relay program once! Like,
you move about while holding this super big
brush and write wishes for the coming
year!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly,
the last participants were baseball players,
weren't they?
One of the players' dog wrote a dot with
its paw, too. Sooo cute.

Haha,
right!
The way they were holding the brush like a
bat and writing letters like 'shwaaa' was
really funny!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
So we've been asked to rep Tracen 
Academy doing that this year, huh…!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
We'd like you to be the face of the new year,
so to speak.
After I spoke with the board director,
we decided on you two.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I chatted with Rudolf beforehand and got
the a-okay! 
C.B., Ace, what do you two think?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fun,
I'm in!
When I was watching the baseball players,
they seemed free to express themselves
however they wanted, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Plus,
with all of you here—
seems like I'll be in good company.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm glad to hear it. 
What say you, Katsuragi Ace?
Hell yeah, I'm in!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
Like C.B. said, seems interesting. 
I gotta give it my all as the Renegade
Ace!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
Good! In that case,
I'll enter the four of us. 
Which leaves just one more…
text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hm? There's still someone else?

Yuppers! Our fifth's going to be Ramonu!
…Though I get a feeling it won't be that
easy—
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, speak of the devil! C'mon in! 
… What's this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um… pardon the intrusion.
I'm Mejiro Ardan, 
entering on behalf of my s— Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha… a substitute, I see. 
Would you mind elaborating on the situation,
Mejiro Ardan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Of course… Well,
when I showed her the proposal,
she said she had no mind to participate…
and told me to go in her stead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it is… but you mustn't hang
your head.
You're actually doing us a great service,
Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing!… Inexperienced though I am,
I'll do my very best to make this event a
success. I'm looking forward to it.

Course! Aight, so it's me and C.B., 
Maruzen, Rudolf, and Ardan—
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
Let's knock this calligraphy performance
outta the park!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Stop, and then the next stroke… 
lift the brush, and avoid the edge…

Oh, Ardan! What's that,
a calligraphy performance video?
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I thought I should look at the performers
from previous years to get an idea of how
they move.

Woah… now that's a good idea! Hey,
can I watch with you?
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
Let's get the movements down-pat before
practice with everyone so we can surprise
the socks off 'em! We got this, Ardan!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe… yes, let's!

Looks like we're set!
Ramonu threw a bit of a wrench in things
like always,
but I think things'll work out… don't you,
Rudolf?
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Agreed.
We won't let a small change like this stop us.
You could call it a change for the better,
or perhaps even an improvement.

In any case,
let us see this through to the end with our
powers combined, Maruzensky.
text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
What is it that you always say… "To bring
bliss to all Umamusume!", right?
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
